articles.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
articles.description: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
articles.description: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

articles.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.description: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

articles.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
articles.description: The Nvidia CEO also pulled out of an Anthropic event earlier.

articles.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
articles.description: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

articles.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
articles.description: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

articles.title: AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
articles.description: Nominal, a startup that offers an AI platform for hardware engineering and claims Anduril as a major customer, has raised another big round of financing that triples its valuation.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
articles.description: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny
articles.description: Jensen Huang’s alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to complicate Nvidia’s lobbying efforts to loosen U.S. chip export restrictions and maintain access to China’s lucrative AI market.

articles.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
articles.description: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.

articles.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
articles.description: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

articles.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
articles.description: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

articles.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
articles.description: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.

articles.title: Uber launches parking service following SpotHero acquisition, with an eye on robotaxis
articles.description: Uber Parking is the latest example of the company offering products beyond its core ride-hailing service.

articles.title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
articles.description: Anthropic bought billions of dollars' worth of natural gas turbines in a deal that could give it buyer's remorse.

articles.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
articles.description: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

articles.title: Medium’s new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
articles.description: Medium's new writing app embraces AI-assisted writing, despite growing controversy over the technology's role in publishing.

articles.title: Meta expands Instagram’s AI age-guessing tech globally
articles.description: Meta says it will use its AI technology to look for clues about people it suspects to be teenagers — even if they use an adult birthday.

articles.title: Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing school buses after software fix, feds say
articles.description: The update to Waymo's self-driving system was rolled out nearly a year ago.
